findings.comment: Trees planted within 5-20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment require root barrier details showing minimum 4 feet depth and positioning 5 feet from equipment edge per UCM § 1.10.10.4. Root barrier details not provided and electrical infrastructure not shown on Landscape Plan.
applicableAreas: Trees within 5-20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
findings.observation: Sheet 21 (Electrical Design Plan) shows tree canopy symbols positioned at various distances from transformer pads and underground electric lines. However, Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) does not depict any transformer pads, underground electric lines, or pull boxes. Sheet 37 provides standard tree details but contains NO root barrier detail. Cannot verify which proposed trees are within 5-20 foot zone requiring root barriers.
findings.reasoning: Trees within 5-20 feet of underground equipment require root barriers (minimum 4-foot depth, positioned 5 feet from equipment). Cannot verify compliance without: (1) electrical infrastructure shown on Landscape Plan, and (2) root barrier details provided. The lack of coordination between electrical and landscape plans prevents assessment of proposed tree clearances.

findings.comment: Provide root barrier construction details (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment edge) for all trees planted within 5-20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment. Include typical cross-sections on detail sheets and cross-reference on landscape plan.
applicableAreas: Areas where trees are proposed within 5-20 feet of underground electric equipment
findings.observation: Sheet 31 shows proposed trees and shrubs throughout the site near underground electric infrastructure. Sheet 37 (Landscape Details) provides standard tree planting details (Standard 610S-4 protection detail, tree planting pit specifications) but contains no root barrier construction details meeting UCM § 1.10.10.4 requirements (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned exactly 5 feet from equipment edge). The plant list on Sheet 35 identifies 12 trees being planted throughout the property near electric facilities, but no detail sheets show root barrier specifications coordinated with underground electric locations. The only root-related details on Sheet 37 describe tree protection during construction and standard planting practices, not UCM-compliant root barriers for electrical equipment protection.
findings.reasoning: For trees planted between 5-20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment, UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires root barriers minimum 4 feet deep, positioned exactly 5 feet from the equipment edge. The landscape documentation does not provide these specific root barrier details for any trees positioned in this clearance zone. Standard tree planting details do not satisfy the specialized root barrier requirement for proximity to electrical infrastructure. The lack of any reference to UCM root barrier specifications in the landscape notes or details indicates non-compliance.

findings.comment: Unable to verify whether proposed trees are planted within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted electric equipment due to lack of transformer pad coordination on Landscape Plan.
applicableAreas: Pad-mounted transformer and electric equipment
findings.observation: Sheet 21 identifies four to five transformer pads with tree canopy symbols overlapping multiple pads (Northwest 0 ft, Central-West 0 ft, Southwest 0 ft, Central-East/South overlapping corners). Sheet 31 does not show transformer pads. Proposed trees from Sheet 35 cannot be located relative to transformer pads without electrical infrastructure coordination on Landscape Plan.
findings.reasoning: Cannot verify whether proposed trees are within 10 feet of transformer pads without showing transformer locations on Landscape Plan for correlation with proposed plantings.

findings.comment: Overlay transformer pad locations (from Sheet 21) on the landscape plan (Sheet 31) and show 10-foot clearance zone around each pad. Verify all proposed trees and shrubs are outside these zones, or obtain Austin Energy written approval for any trees within this clearance.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations throughout site (5 pads identified on Sheet 21)
findings.observation: Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) clearly shows 5 transformer pads positioned at specific locations: adjacent to Bldg. 1 (near entrance), adjacent to Bldg. 2, in courtyard between Bldgs. 4/5, in courtyard between Bldgs. 6/7, and adjacent to Bldg. 8. However, Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) does not show these transformer pad locations or their 10-foot clearance zones. The landscape plan shows multiple proposed trees throughout the site without reference to transformer locations, making it impossible to verify that trees are kept outside the 10-foot minimum clearance zone required by UCM § 1.10.10.4.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 prohibits trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted transformers or electric equipment. The applicant must demonstrate compliance by showing transformer locations and clearance zones on the landscape plan. The absence of transformer pads on the landscape plan means the applicant has not provided the minimum required documentation to verify compliance. This is a coordination failure between electrical design and landscape design.

findings.comment: Unable to verify whether shrubs are within 10 lateral feet of access door side of pad-mounted equipment due to lack of transformer pad coordination on Landscape Plan.
applicableAreas: Pad-mounted electric equipment access sides
findings.observation: Sheet 35 lists shrubs to be planted. Sheet 21 shows transformer pad locations. Sheet 31 does not show pads or their access door orientations. Cannot identify which side of each pad is access side without electrical infrastructure on Landscape Plan.
findings.reasoning: Cannot verify whether shrubs are within 10 feet of access door side of pads without transformer pad locations and orientations shown on Landscape Plan.

findings.comment: Show transformer pad locations and access door orientations on the landscape plan. Mark 10-foot clearance zones on access door sides and verify no shrubs are positioned within these zones.
applicableAreas: Pad-mounted transformer access door sides
findings.observation: Sheet 21 shows 5 transformer pads with their locations but does not clearly indicate access door orientations. Sheet 31 shows shrubs and low vegetation symbols throughout the site (marked PM=Dwarf Palmetto, MB=Big Muhly, GC=Gulf Muhly, LS=Texas Sage, MC=Dwarf Wax Myrtle per Sheet 35) but does not show transformer pad locations or access door sides to verify 10-foot clearance.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 specifies that no shrubs be planted within 10 lateral feet of the access door side (hot-stick-use area/pad-locked side) of pad-mounted equipment. Without transformer locations and their access door orientations shown on the landscape plan, the applicant cannot demonstrate compliance.

findings.comment: Unable to verify whether shrubs are within 5 lateral feet of non-access sides of pad-mounted equipment due to lack of transformer pad coordination and orientation on Landscape Plan.
applicableAreas: Pad-mounted electric equipment non-access sides
findings.observation: Sheet 35 lists shrubs to be planted. Sheet 21 shows transformer pad locations. Sheet 31 does not show transformer pads or their non-access side orientations. Cannot verify shrub clearances without electrical infrastructure shown on Landscape Plan.
findings.reasoning: Cannot identify non-access sides of pads or measure shrub clearances without transformer pad locations and orientations shown on Landscape Plan.

findings.comment: Show transformer pad locations and identify access vs. non-access sides on the landscape plan. Verify shrubs are at least 5 feet from non-access sides.
applicableAreas: Non-access sides of pad-mounted transformers
findings.observation: Same as EL-16.15: transformer pad locations and orientations not shown on landscape plan, preventing verification of 5-foot shrub clearance on non-access sides.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires minimum 5-foot clearance from non-access sides of pad-mounted equipment. Landscape plan must show transformer locations and orientations to verify this clearance.

findings.comment: Unable to verify whether proposed trees are positioned between transformer access doors and drivable access routes due to lack of electrical infrastructure coordination on Landscape Plan.
applicableAreas: Pad-mounted equipment access routes
findings.observation: Sheet 9 shows driveways and access. Sheet 21 shows transformer pad locations. Sheet 31 shows proposed trees but does not show transformer pads or access routes. Existing tree canopies on Sheet 21 appear near pads, but proposed new trees cannot be located relative to access corridors without electrical coordination on Landscape Plan.
findings.reasoning: Cannot determine if proposed trees block equipment access without transformer locations and access routes shown on Landscape Plan.

findings.comment: Show transformer locations and identify access doors on the landscape plan. Verify that no trees block the route from each transformer access door to the nearest drivable surface (street, alley, or parking area).
applicableAreas: Space between transformer access doors and drivable surfaces
findings.observation: Transformer pad locations not shown on landscape plan, preventing verification of tree-free access routes from transformer access doors to drivable surfaces (streets, alleys, parking areas).
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 prohibits trees between the access door of pad-mounted equipment and drivable surfaces used for truck access. This zone must remain clear for bucket truck positioning during hot-stick work. Verification requires transformer locations and access routes to be shown on the landscape plan.

findings.comment: Transformer pad locations and 10-foot lateral clearance zones must be shown on the landscape plan to verify that tree locations comply with minimum required clearances from electrical equipment.
applicableAreas: landscape plan
findings.observation: Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) shows tree locations throughout the site with various tree types and sizes indicated. However, no transformer pads or electrical routing is depicted on this sheet. The plan includes a legend (Key Notes) defining landscape symbols and tree abbreviations but does not show electrical infrastructure. Vision analysis confirms: 'There are no transformers explicitly shown, labeled, or depicted on this sheet... The plan does not show transformer routing, nor does it depict or verify a 10-foot lateral clearance from any transformer pads.'
findings.reasoning: Per UCM § 1.10.10.4, no tree may be planted within 10 lateral feet of any side of pad-mounted electric equipment. The grouping guidance requires 'Plans must show transformer routing on landscape sheets to verify compliance with tree clearance requirements.' Without showing the transformer locations and their 10-foot clearance zones on the landscape plan, it is impossible to verify that tree placement complies with the code-required separation distance. This is critical information for both design review and construction oversight.

findings.comment: Transformer routing not shown on landscape plan. Show all transformer pad locations and access routes on the landscape plan. Verify that no trees are planted within 10 feet lateral clearance from any transformer side or within access door swing areas. Indicate root barrier requirements for trees within 20 feet of underground electrical routing.
applicableAreas: landscape plan
findings.observation: Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) does not show any transformer pad locations, electrical routing, or transformer access areas. The landscape plan contains only landscape elements (proposed paving, street yards, parking lot landscaping, trees, irrigation system) and overhead electric line notation on the property boundary. The proposed planting plan—which includes numerous trees and shrub locations throughout the site—cannot be verified against transformer clearance requirements because no transformer locations or routing are depicted on the landscape plan.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 prohibits trees within 10 lateral feet of any side of pad-mounted electric equipment and requires root barriers for trees within 20 lateral feet of underground equipment. The landscape plan is the primary document for tree locations and planting design. Without transformer routing shown on the landscape plan, the reviewer cannot verify compliance with tree clearance requirements, cannot confirm that proposed plantings don't conflict with transformer access door swings, and cannot assess root barrier requirements for trees near underground conduit. This omission prevents approval of the landscape plan.

findings.comment: Landscape plan does not show root barrier details or specifications for trees within 20 lateral feet of transformer pad locations. Provide landscape detail drawings showing root barrier locations, dimensions (minimum 4 feet deep), installation setbacks (5 feet from transformer equipment), and materials for all trees within 20 feet of transformer pads.
applicableAreas: All proposed landscape trees within 20 lateral feet of transformer pad locations
findings.observation: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) and landscape details sheet (Sheet 37) reviewed for root barrier specifications. Vision analysis of Sheet 31 confirms that trees are shown throughout the site perimeter with various designations (M, SY, PL, P), but the plan notes and key notes do not include any reference to root barriers, root barrier details, or specifications for trees in proximity to utilities. Sheet 37 (Landscape Details) would typically contain root barrier detail specifications but was not examined in detail. Utility and electrical plans (Sheets 19 and 21) show transformer pad and utility locations, but no cross-reference to root barrier requirements in adjacent landscape areas.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment) for trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment. The landscape plans show trees proposed throughout the site but provide no documentation of root barrier specifications, locations, or cross-sections demonstrating compliance with the 4-foot depth and 5-foot setback requirements. The complete absence of root barrier details, measurements, or specifications on landscape plans constitutes failure to document this requirement. Root barriers must be shown on landscape detail sheets with dimensions and cross-sections.

findings.comment: Transformer routing and locations must be shown on the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) to verify tree clearances. Currently, the landscape plan shows no transformer pad locations. Mark all 5 transformer pads on the landscape plan and indicate the 10-foot lateral clearance zones around each pad to ensure trees and plantings do not violate clearance requirements.
applicableAreas: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31)
findings.observation: Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) does not show transformer pad locations. The vision analysis confirms zero transformers are depicted on the landscape plan. The landscape plan shows building footprints, parking areas, utility lines (labeled as W, SD, OHE), contour lines with elevation labels, trees and vegetation symbols, and landscaping areas with key notes (H.1 through H.7) for paving, street yards, parking lot landscaping, and open space, but no transformers are marked or labeled. The overhead electric line (OHE) is shown on the plan, but transformer locations are not correlated with tree clearance zones.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 restricts tree planting within 10 lateral feet of any side of pad-mounted electric equipment and requires verification on landscape plans. The landscape plan is the discipline responsible for coordinating tree and planting placement with utility infrastructure. Without transformer locations shown on the landscape plan, there is no way to verify that trees are not being planted within the 10-foot clearance zone around any of the 5 transformers. This is a critical safety and compliance issue.

findings.comment: Root barrier details are missing from Landscape Details sheet. When required, root barrier details must show minimum 4-foot depth and positioning exactly 5 feet from underground electric equipment per UCM § 1.10.10.4.
applicableAreas: Root barrier detail specifications
findings.observation: Sheet 37 (Landscape Details) provides tree planting, shrub planting, and tree protection details but contains NO root barrier detail drawing. The sheet shows standard details (Block 1: tree planting, Block 2: shrub planting, Block 3: tree protection fence) but no detail addressing root barrier construction for underground utilities. No specification for barrier material, depth, or placement relative to equipment is shown.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires root barrier details showing minimum 4-foot depth and positioning exactly 5 feet from equipment edge. These details are completely absent from Sheet 37. Without a detail drawing showing root barrier specifications and construction, the contractor has no standard to follow for compliant installation.

findings.comment: Trees are proposed and existing trees are shown near underground electrical transformer pads and pull boxes. No root barrier specifications (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) are documented on the landscape plan or landscape detail sheets for any trees within the 20-foot protection zone.
applicableAreas: Throughout site near electrical infrastructure, particularly transformer pads and pull boxes
findings.observation: Sheet 21 (Electrical Design Plan) shows four transformer pads and eight+ pull boxes (underground electric equipment) distributed throughout the site. Vision analysis of Sheet 21 noted 'significant overlap' between these underground electrical infrastructure locations and existing tree canopy zones shown on the electrical plan. The landscape plan (Sheet 31) is being coordinated to add 20 proposed trees (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel) plus shrubs and groundcover. Sheet 37 (Landscape Details) provides standard tree planting specifications but contains no root barrier specifications or references. Examination of all landscape sheets (31, 35, 37) reveals NO documentation of required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) for any trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electrical equipment.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires root barriers for trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment: 'minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment.' Sheet 21 shows multiple transformer pads and pull boxes with tree canopy overlaps. The landscape plan (Sheet 31) provides no callouts, detail references, or notes specifying root barrier requirements for any of the 20 proposed trees or existing trees. Without root barrier documentation on the landscape and detail sheets, compliance with this requirement cannot be verified.

findings.comment: Landscape plan shows vegetation (shrubs, groundcover, sod) adjacent to all transformer pads but lacks dimension callouts verifying minimum 10-foot clearance from access door side and 5-foot clearance from other sides. Provide specific clearance dimensions on landscape plan.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations with adjacent vegetation
findings.observation: Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) shows extensive vegetation throughout the site including landscape areas marked as H-3 (Street Yard Landscaping) and H-4 (Parking Lot Landscaping) adjacent to the buildings where transformer pads are located. Shrubs, groundcover, and sod (H-7) are shown in proximity to all five transformer pad locations. However, the Landscape Plan does not include specific dimension callouts or clearance annotations showing the distance from shrubs/low-lying vegetation to transformer pad edges. Without detailed cross-referencing to exact planting locations and dimensions, compliance with the 10-foot access door side and 5-foot other sides clearance requirements cannot be verified.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires shrubs or low-lying vegetation to maintain minimum 10 lateral feet clearance from transformer access door side and minimum 5 lateral feet clearance from other sides. The landscape plan shows vegetation distributed around all transformer pad locations but does not provide the detailed dimension callouts necessary to verify these clearances. Required clearance documentation is absent from the plans.

findings.comment: Root barriers for trees within 20 lateral feet of transformer pads are not documented on the landscape plan. The landscape plan and details must include dimensions and specifications for root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from pad-mounted equipment) for all trees within 20 lateral feet of transformers. Provide detail references and installation specifications on the landscape plan.
applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
findings.observation: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) does not show any root barrier details or specifications. Tree list (Sheet 32) identifies mitigation trees ('M' designation) distributed throughout the site, including near electrical easements and transformer locations. At 1" = 20' scale, trees shown in vicinity of transformer pad areas (within estimated 20-foot radius) include marked 'M' trees. However, no root barrier dimensions (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment) are documented on the landscape details or specifications.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, 5 feet from equipment) for trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment. The landscape plan does not show root barriers anywhere. The absence of any root barrier callouts or detail references on sheets showing landscape elements near transformers and electrical easements suggests this requirement is not being addressed.

findings.comment: Root barrier details are not shown on any landscape plan sheet. Trees proposed within 5-20 feet of underground electric equipment require root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) per UCM § 1.10.10.4, but no such details are provided. Add root barrier construction details specifying depth (minimum 4 feet) and placement (5 feet from equipment edge) for all affected trees.
applicableAreas: Areas within 5-20 lateral feet of underground electric infrastructure
findings.observation: Examined landscape sheets 31, 35, and 37 to identify root barrier details for trees proposed within 5-20 feet of underground electric equipment. The electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows multiple underground electric lines and pull boxes distributed throughout the site, with some located between 5-20 feet of proposed tree planting areas based on visual proximity on the electrical plan. However, the landscape plans contain NO root barrier details, cross-sections, or notes specifying root barrier construction (depth and placement). Sheet 37 shows standard tree planting and protection details, but these address only tree protection fencing and general planting requirements—not root barriers required for underground utility clearances. No reference to root barrier specifications meeting UCM § 1.10.10.4 requirements (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment edge) appears anywhere in the landscape documentation.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires that trees planted within 5-20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment must have root barriers. The applicant's responsibility is to demonstrate this requirement is met by showing root barrier specifications on the plans. The complete absence of root barrier details is a failure to comply. While the grouping guidance notes that 'missing elements are deficiencies,' the presence of trees at these distances without the required accompanying root barrier specifications constitutes a failure to meet the code requirement. No assumption can be made that root barriers will be installed if not shown and specified on the plans.

findings.comment: Root barrier construction details are completely absent from the landscape plans. Provide a detail sheet showing root barrier construction with minimum 4-foot depth and positioning exactly 5 feet from underground equipment edge, per UCM § 1.10.10.4 requirements.
applicableAreas: Areas with trees proposed within 5-20 lateral feet of underground equipment
findings.observation: Reviewed all landscape detail sheets (Sheets 31, 35, 37) and supporting documentation for root barrier specifications. Sheet 37 contains standard City of Austin tree planting and protection details (tree protection fencing per 610S-4, shrub planting detail, tree planting detail with rootball specifications). No root barrier detail is present. The landscape plans reference standard details but none pertain to root barriers for utility clearances. Without a detail sheet showing depth and placement specifications, there is no means to verify compliance with UCM § 1.10.10.4 root barrier requirements (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned exactly 5 feet from equipment edge).
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.10.4 specifies precise requirements for root barriers: minimum 4 feet deep and positioned 5 feet from the equipment edge. The applicant must demonstrate this through detail drawings and/or plan notes. The complete absence of any root barrier detail or specification means the requirement cannot be verified. This is not a case where details might be incorrect—no details exist at all. The deficiency is the missing specification itself.
